Task: Pub/Sub Messaging

Write Python code that sends failed messages to a dead-letter destination using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
from google.cloud.pubsub_v1.types import DeadLetterPolicy

# Initialize the Pub/Sub client
publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()

# Set environment variables for project and topic names
project_id = os.getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID", "your-project-id")
topic_name = os.getenv("PUBSUB_TOPIC", "projects/{project_id}/topics/{topic_name}".format(
    project_id=project_id, topic_name="source-topic"))
dead_letter_topic_name = os.getenv("PUBSUB_DL_TOPIC", "projects/{project_id}/topics/{topic_name}".format(
    project_id=project_id, topic_name="dead-letter-topic"))

# Create the dead-letter policy configuration
dead_letter_policy = DeadLetterPolicy(
    dead_letter_topic=dead_letter_topic_name,
    max_delivery_attempts=5
)

# Create the subscription with dead-letter policy
subscription_path = subscriber.subscription_path(project_id, "subscription-with-dlq")
flow_control = pubsub_v1.types.FlowControl(max_messages=1000)

subscription = subscriber.create_subscription(
    request=pubsub_v1.types.Subscription(
        name=subscription_path,
        topic=topic_name,
        dead_letter_policy=dead_letter_policy,
        flow_control=flow_control
    )
)

print(f"Created subscription {subscription.name} with dead-letter topic {dead_letter_policy.dead_letter_topic}")
```
